about: Pass 3 (C2a-03): the one arrow the pass 3 order tests admit, from c2_arrow_evidence-p3a.txt; mechanism and failure clause as declared in notes-C2.md before the count. The other six tests are dropped or informative only (notes-C2.md, pass 3).
sample_rule: sampled_against: rooms carrying both elements, drawn by random.Random(20261014) in c2_arrow_evidence.py (pass 3, no room excluded); holds when the connection statement holds in that room, fails when it does not; the first concepts of each were read in c2_first_concepts.py for the failure clause

arrows.connection: in a room carrying both, the first call to the canvas comes before the first line the host sub draws around canvas talk (a megathread, a removal by rule, a changed rule, a canvas sub, an objection to the flood, a dismissal of the canvas)
arrows.grounding_note: Cited concepts of the call themes (all of Mobilization) against all of Boundary work; 29 transitions in 22 rooms where a pointer to the megathread, a removal or an objection to the flood answers a call within minutes. The 23 rooms where the line comes first were read by their first concepts (c2_first_concepts-P01-P20-fails-p3.txt). Disconfirming: the line drawn only before any call, or lines that name no canvas flood.
arrows.mechanism: Calls to the canvas flood the host sub, and its moderators or members answer by drawing a line around canvas talk: one thread, removals, a canvas sub.
arrows.mechanism_fails_if: In a room, the line comes before any call, or the line's words name no canvas flood.
sampled: the first line (h80.40) is a member's judgment of the canvas's worth after the close; it names no flood, so the mechanism is not shown here
the first line removes separate canvas posts into a megathread (h53.56)
the first line opens a canvas sub to leave the messy comment section (h9.41)
the first line asks to gather the scattered canvas posts into one megathread (h72.02)
arrows.bound: Partly constitutive: a removal by rule needs a post to remove, and an objection to the flood needs canvas posts. 23 of 155 rooms draw the line first: the sub's automatic rules remove the first call as it is posted (9 rooms, three in the same hour), a canvas sub or a megathread is set up before the host sub carries any call (7), or members dismiss the canvas or object to other rooms' canvas posts before the room calls (7).
arrows.counterexample_response: 23 of 155 rooms draw the line first, and one sampled room (transformers) shows a line that answers no flood. Alternatives considered: the arrow as a definition (an objection to the flood needs a flood), and the line as the host sub's standing temper rather than an answer. Against both, 29 transitions show a line answering a specific call within minutes, and the rule-bound removals answer the room's own call posts. Response: kept strong; the removal of a call as it is posted is the same mechanism at no delay; a canvas sub set up first and an early dismissal are scope conditions in the bound.
arrows.gloss: calls flood the host sub, and the host draws a line
